dml_changes.description: Isolate old preparing/published prepared facts using existing quarantined state without resuming source IDs; retain manifests and raw ownership. Retire only grace-expired unowned artifacts.
Publish one task-local batch to the canonical monthly target and transform verified source rows in short transactions; failed live rows are reselected rather than resumed.
Append optional throughput fields to immutable maintenance run details; missing historical fields stay unknown.

recovery.faulty_release_recovery: A forward version verifies existing manifest/file replacement facts, discards abandoned task-local work, and reselects remaining live source rows. It does not resume old candidate IDs, temporary files, cursors or accumulators.
